expected_items.description: Interpret the user's principle-adherence request as a durable instruction and reusable governance agent.
expected_items.rationale: The request was summarized and the plan records the Principle Guardian agent interpretation.

expected_items.description: Run web-first research and save a public search record.
expected_items.rationale: The search record lists queries, sources checked, weak sources ignored, plan impact, and uncertainty.

expected_items.description: Add or link the durable requirement for principle adherence.
Create an inspectable Principle Guardian agent spec with guarded principles, escalation rules, and validation commands.
expected_items.rationale: The agent spec includes trigger, output contract, principle sources, guarded principles, escalation rules, and validation commands.

expected_items.description: Persist the instruction that all agents strongly adhere to principles.
expected_items.rationale: Durable instructions now state principles are execution contracts and close-out gates.

expected_items.description: Ensure speed, profit, optimism, convenience, or pressure cannot bypass evidence, safety, privacy, legality, quality, provenance, validation, or evaluation.
expected_items.rationale: The persistent instructions and agent policy explicitly block principle-bypassing shortcuts.

acceptance_checks.description: Confirm the new agent appears in the registry list.
Confirm durable instruction changes do not break bootstrap.
Run platform tests and monitor build checks.
acceptance_checks.rationale: All commands completed with exit code 0.

known_omission_risks: No separate runtime supervisor was implemented because this request was satisfied by durable instructions and an inspectable governance agent spec.
notes: The agent complements existing guard agents by judging principle conflicts across them.
